goals.description: Execute comprehensive audit targeting multi-app portability, free-tier AI API limitations (429/503, timeouts, failover, think tags), and Qdrant continuous learning gaps
goals.verificationCriteria: Structured audit findings document detailing exact failure modes, missing abstractions, and architecture requirements across File Structure, AI Setup, and Qdrant Utilization
goals.evidence: Generated .omg/ultragoal/audit_v2.md identifying: (1) Core primitives scattered across UI directory with leaky web schemas; (2) Critical lack of AI failover cascades for free-tier 429/503 errors and hanging fetch calls without timeouts; (3) Absence of Qdrant multi-app namespacing (appId), feedback reinforcement, semantic deduplication, and compound payload indexing.

goals.description: Consolidate Core Swarm into a self-contained, zero-leak package structure with clean exports for multi-app transplantation
goals.verificationCriteria: All swarm core primitives (memory, router, lifecycle, state, schemas, adapters) reside within src/swarm/ with proper exports; zero React/Vite dependencies required by the swarm library
goals.evidence: Relocated memory, router, lifecycle, state, orchestrator, profiler, and generic analysis schemas into src/swarm/ with 0 external ../ imports; defined subpath exports in package.json; preserved backward-compatible root shims; verified via tsc, vite build, and native node direct import (23 exports).

goals.description: Implement Free-Tier AI Resilience Engine: multi-provider failover cascades, request timeouts with AbortController, and reasoning model tag sanitization
goals.verificationCriteria: Agent automatically cascades to backup providers upon 429/503/timeouts; requests abort after configurable deadline; <think> tags stripped cleanly without corrupting JSON
goals.evidence: Implemented ProviderCredential failover chain in Agent.run triggering on 429 rate limits, quotas, 5xx errors, and timeouts; added 30s AbortSignal.timeout across Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, and GitHub adapters; built sanitizeModelOutput stripping <think>...</think> reasoning blocks and markdown fences; verified via automated test in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: Upgrade Qdrant Memory Cortex into a Multi-App Learning Engine: multi-tenant appId namespacing, feedback scoring, semantic deduplication, and few-shot exemplary learning retrieval
goals.verificationCriteria: MemoryCortex isolates memories by appId; indexes appId/qualityRating/domain in Qdrant; prevents vector duplication via cosine thresholding; retrieves top-rated exemplars for prompt reinforcement
goals.evidence: Implemented multi-tenant appId isolation, cosine deduplication threshold (>0.92), rateMemory reinforcement scoring, and retrieveExemplars few-shot prompt distillation in MemoryCortex; integrated into swarmEngine.ts; verified via unit tests in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: End-to-end multi-app simulation, typecheck, build, and free-tier stress testing
goals.verificationCriteria: tsc --noEmit passes cleanly; vite build succeeds; multi-app learning simulation test script executes successfully under node --experimental-strip-types
goals.evidence: Executed comprehensive test suite: tsc --noEmit passed (0 errors); vite build succeeded (dist/assets bundled cleanly); node --experimental-strip-types test-portable-swarm.ts passed all 12 validation steps; test-multi-app-simulation.ts verified multi-tenant deployment across FinTech & Health apps, 429 failover recovery, <think> sanitization, feedback reinforcement, and 12-task parallel stress test with 100% success.
